Kind.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Kinds]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Kinds] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [s] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [s40] NVARCHAR(40) NULL, [c] CHAR(4) NULL, [t] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, [i] INTEGER NULL, [bi] BIGINT NULL, [si] SMALLINT NULL, [f] FLOAT NULL, [d] DOUBLE PRECISION NULL, [dec] DECIMAL NULL, [dec2] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL, [b] BIT NULL, [dt] DATETIMEOFFSET NULL, [don] DATE NULL, [tm] TIME NULL, [u] CHAR(36) NULL, [bl] VARBINARY(MAX) NULL, [e] VARCHAR(255) CHECK ([e] IN(N'a', N'b')), [ev] VARCHAR(255) CHECK ([ev] IN(N'x', N'y')), [createdAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updatedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

attributes.id: INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY

Defaults.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Defaults]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Defaults] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [s] NVARCHAR(255) DEFAULT N'it''s', [c] CHAR(2) DEFAULT N'ab', [t] NVARCHAR(MAX) DEFAULT N'tt', [i] INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, [n] INTEGER DEFAULT -3, [bi] BIGINT DEFAULT 10, [f] FLOAT DEFAULT 1.5, [d] DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 2, [dec] DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 1.25, [b] BIT DEFAULT 1, [bf] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, [e] VARCHAR(255) CHECK ([e] IN(N'x', N'y')), [nul] NVARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, [now] DATETIMEOFFSET NULL, [uid] CHAR(36) NULL, [lit] NVARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'lit', [createdAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updatedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

attributes.id: INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY

Uniques.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Uniques]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Uniques] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [a] NVARCHAR(255) NULL UNIQUE, [g1] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [g2] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [n] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [off] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [createdAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updatedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [pair] UNIQUE ([g1], [g2]), CONSTRAINT [solo] UNIQUE ([n]), PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

Keys.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Keys]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Keys] ([code] NVARCHAR(255) , [other] INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([code]));

attributes.id: CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY

UuidKey.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[UuidKeys]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [UuidKeys] ([id] CHAR(36) , [v] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

BigKey.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[BigKeys]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [BigKeys] ([id] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) , [v] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

Stamps.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Stamps]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Stamps] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [v] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [made] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [deletedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NULL, [version] INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

Snake.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[snakes]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [snakes] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [read_count] INTEGER NULL, [heading] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [created_at] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updated_at] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

User.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Users]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Users] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [name] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [createdAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updatedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]));

attributes.id: INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY

Memo.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Memos]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Memos] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [title] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [createdAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updatedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [authorId] INTEGER NULL, [editorId] INTEGER NULL, [parentId] INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]), FOREIGN KEY ([authorId]) REFERENCES [Users] ([id]) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY ([editorId]) REFERENCES [Users] ([id]), FOREIGN KEY ([parentId]) REFERENCES [Memos] ([id]));

attributes.id: INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY

Team.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Teams]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Teams] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [name] NVARCHAR(255) NULL, [createdAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updatedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [OrgId] INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]), FOREIGN KEY ([OrgId]) REFERENCES [Orgs] ([id]) ON DELETE SET NULL);

Pin.sql: IF OBJECT_ID('[Pins]', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE [Pins] ([id] INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) , [a] INTEGER NULL, [b] INTEGER NULL, [c] INTEGER NULL, [createdAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, [updatedAt] DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ([id]), FOREIGN KEY ([a]) REFERENCES [Orgs] ([id]) ON DELETE SET NULL, FOREIGN KEY ([b]) REFERENCES [Orgs] ([id]), FOREIGN KEY ([c]) REFERENCES [Users] ([id]));
